ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, which labeled region is the end of a neuron?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a neuron structure; on the left side there is a cell body and many branch-like protrusions; from the cell body a long axon extends to the right, and outside the axon there are segmented myelin sheath-like structures; the far right end is a branched terminal structure. The indication line of label D points to the tip area of these branched terminals on the far right. Reasoning: The question asks which labeled area is the “end of the neuron.” The end of a neuron is usually the axon terminal, that is, the branch terminal located at the end of the axon far from the cell body. This position in the figure is marked by label D, therefore the answer is D.
